title: Fixed Income Blog - When positioning becomes a policy problem

classification.rationale: The note argues that hedge fund leverage and NBFI interconnections amplify bond market shocks, and examines the reforms and central bank backstops that policymakers are weighing.
classification.runner_up_reason: A large share of the note covers clearing, haircut and surveillance reforms, but the central argument is about stress amplification and the limits of central bank backstops.
